name: Dolphin

biosRequirements.label: GameCube IPL (optional)
biosRequirements.note: Optional. Dolphin boots games without it using high-level emulation.

notes: OmniDeck launches Dolphin with -b (batch) so stopping emulation exits back to OmniDeck.
Dolphin's User folder is kept outside the program folder (-u) so updates and rollbacks never touch settings or saves.
assumptions: Verified against Dolphin master source: CLI options -u/--user, -e/--exec, -b/--batch, -C/--config <System>.<Section>.<Key>=<Value>, -v/--video_backend (Source/Core/UICommon/CommandLineParse.cpp).
The official update endpoint https://dolphin-emu.org/update/latest/<track>/ returns JSON with artifacts[{system:'Windows x64', url}] (same endpoint used by EmuDeck's Windows edition).

Keys: [Core] GFXBackend (D3D, D3D12, Vulkan, OGL), EmulationSpeed, MemcardAPath, MemcardBPath; [General] NANDRootPath; [Display] Fullscreen; [Interface] ConfirmStop; GFX.ini [Settings] InternalResolution, AspectRatio; [Hardware] VSync.
XInput device names: XInput/<n>/Gamepad with inputs 'Button A', 'Pad N', 'Shoulder L', 'Trigger L', 'Thumb L', 'Left X+'. SDL devices use 'Button S/E/W/N' (SDLGamepad.h).
Hotkey keys are '<Group>/<Label>', e.g. 'General/Stop', 'Save State/Save to Selected Slot' (Source/Core/Core/HotkeyManager.cpp).
